d: Provide comprehensive executive, administrative, and coordination support to the CEO of Bahrain LNG, ensuring the efficient management of schedules, communications, meetings, documentation, and stakeholder engagement activities. The role serves as a key point of contact between the CEO and internal and external stakeholders while maintaining the highest levels of professionalism, confidentiality, and organizational effectiveness.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Office Management, Secretarial Studies, Communications, or a related discipline.
5-8 years of experience in executive assistance, office administration, or senior administrative support roles, preferably supporting C-suite executives.
Experience in the energy, oil & gas, LNG, or industrial sector is desirable.
Strong organizational, planning, and multitasking skills.
Ability to manage changing priorities, take initiative, and work effectively with minimal supervision.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language proficiency is an advantage.
Understanding of the Bahrain business environment is desirable.
Experience in HR administration is an advantage.
High level of confidentiality, professionalism, and attention to detail.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
r: li
Manage and coordinate the CEO's calendar, appointments, meetings, and travel arrangements.
li
Screen, prioritize, and respond to correspondence, emails, and requests on behalf of the CEO.
li
Prepare agendas, presentations, reports, briefing materials, and other documents required by the CEO.
li
Monitor action items and follow up with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely completion.
li
Organize executive, management, and board-related meetings.
li
Prepare meeting packs, agendas, minutes, and action trackers.
li
Ensure accurate documentation and maintenance of meeting records and confidential files.
li
Serve as a liaison between the CEO and internal departments, shareholders, government entities, partners, and external stakeholders.
li
Coordinate communications and ensure timely dissemination of information.
li
Support the CEO in managing stakeholder relationships and engagement activities.
li
Maintain organized records, filing systems, and confidential documentation.
li
Coordinate office logistics, events, workshops, and executive visits.
li
Support procurement and administrative processes related to executive office requirements.
li
Assist with onboarding and offboarding activities, employee documentation, and induction arrangements.
li
Support interview scheduling, candidate coordination, and recruitment administration activities.
li
Maintain accurate personnel records and assist with leave, attendance, and employee data updates in accordance with company procedures.
li
Provide coordination support for employee engagement initiatives and HR communications.
li
Compile data, reports, and presentations for executive and board-level reviews.
li
Track key deadlines, commitments, and deliverables assigned by the CEO.
li
Ensure proper document control and compliance with organizational procedures.
li
Handle highly sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
li
Ensure adherence to company policies, governance requirements, and administrative standards.
li
Support governance processes through accurate record-keeping and compliance monitoring.

d: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

On an exclusive island in the heart of the Kingdom’s capital, Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay, with its unique architecture, has become an iconic landmark that soars as a destination in its own right, combining the best of a beach holiday and an urban getaway.

We are seeking a passionate and talented Junior Sous Chef to join our dynamic culinary team. The ideal candidate will assist in leading kitchen operations, ensuring the highest standards of quality, presentation, and consistency in line with Four Seasons’ luxury standards.
q: We are looking for candidates who are currently working at the Junior Sous Chef level or above, with relevant experience and the ability to perform at this level.
Minimum 2–3 years of culinary experience, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine dining environment.
Strong knowledge of international cuisine and modern cooking techniques.
Ability to work under pressure and maintain high standards.
Culinary degree or equivalent certification is preferred.
r: li
Support the Sous Chef in managing daily kitchen operations.
li
Supervise and guide junior team members to maintain quality and efficiency.
li
Ensure all dishes meet Four Seasons’ standards for taste, presentation, and hygiene.
li
Assist in menu planning, costing, and inventory control.
li
Maintain compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations.
li
Foster a positive and collaborative work environment.
